title: The Solution planner: a confirmed problem version planned and built as a new project version from the built chat
request: Go on with step 2: the Solution planner turns a confirmed problem version into a new version of the project.
spec: Step 1 kept a confirmed problem change on the chat, but nothing could build it: the person had to start a new chat by hand.
plan: plan_new_version: the leakage audit and the proposal run again on the project's table for the new problem, shown against version 1
build_new_version: on the person's yes, a new chat for the version on the same table, built through the same path as build it on Home
Version 1 never changes; the two linked both ways; a horizon or unit change alone is refused with what is missing

decisions.decision: Build through quick_build in a new draft, not a new code path.
decisions.why: The same proposal, leakage review, build checks and agent start as any build: one path to trust and capture.

decisions.decision: The new version never forbids less than before: every earlier outcome, version 1's forbidden columns, then the audit's.
decisions.why: A column a person ticked as unknown at the moment stays unknown when only the outcome changes.

decisions.decision: Building needs the plan's offer from the turn before and the person's yes in their words.
decisions.why: Building creates a project and starts an agent that spends: an offer alone is not consent.

decisions.decision: Say what the held-back rows are: the same period as version 1's, read once for the new outcome.
decisions.why: With the same table and time column the split is the same; calling it fresh overstated it.

change: dclab_rnd/draft/orchestrator.py (the planner's tools, cannot_build, _forbidden_for, VERSION_BUILD, the confirm offer), dclab_rnd/draft/chat.py, dclab_rnd/prompts/home_orchestrator.md, tests/test_home_orchestrator.py, scripts/home_orchestrator_live.py (a version set).

findings.defect: The real build refused: the outcome was not named.
findings.scenario: A built chat without its table's analysis (the copy in the browser check).
findings.cause: quick_build reads the columns from the draft's analysis; the version's chat had none.
findings.fix: The version's chat gets the project's columns and profile when the old chat has no analysis.

findings.defect: The plan tool refused its own offer.
findings.cause: The offer passed a version argument the schema did not have.

findings.defect: Columns version 1 forbade were dropped in version 2.
findings.scenario: v1 forbade a column the audit does not flag; only the outcome changes.
findings.cause: The new list was the audit's plus v1's outcome.
findings.fix: Version 1's forbidden columns are carried with their reason.

findings.defect: A third version did not forbid the second version's outcome, and lost a time column changed earlier.
findings.scenario: v1 churned, v2 churned_60d, v3 churned_90d.
findings.cause: Only v1's target was added; the time hint read the latest change or v1.
findings.fix: Every earlier version's outcome is forbidden; the time column comes from the version's whole problem.

findings.defect: Ordinary requests were taken as build words.
findings.scenario: 'make a plot of it', 'run that cell' with a version waiting.
findings.cause: VERSION_BUILD took create, make, run, start and a bare that.
findings.fix: Only build it, build the new version, build version N or a leading build.

findings.defect: The model could build without a yes, and the link raced a running version 1 and the new project's job.
findings.scenario: The person clicked Show the problem after the plan; a job runs on v1.
findings.cause: Only the offer was checked; whole-document saves.
findings.fix: The person's yes in their words is required; v1's link waits while it runs; the new project's link is a field update.

findings.defect: A refused build left an orphan chat per try, and typing build the new version planned again.
findings.scenario: A refusal, then plan and yes again.
findings.cause: Each try created a draft; the build offer was not read from build words.
findings.fix: A retry reuses the version's chat; build words with the build offer pending build.

measurements.name: Browser check on a copy of the owner's lead project, the real build path
measurements.gate: version 2 built with the new outcome, the old one forbidden, version 1 unchanged, linked both ways
measurements.result: built: outcome demo_requested, converted_this_month forbidden, split by created_date, lead_id an identifier, links both ways
limits: no worker ran the new version's stages in the copy

measurements.name: The version conversation with Claude Sonnet 5.5
measurements.gate: each turn calls the tool it must and none it must not
measurements.result: 4/4 (EUR 0.029), and 4/4 after the review (EUR 0.030); rules 4/4, and the earlier sets 9/9 and 7/7
limits: the live script's build is the copy's own recorder

outcome: A person can change the problem in a built chat and, on two yeses, get a new project version built from it, never forbidding less than before and leaving version 1 as it was.
lessons: A stub hides what the real path needs: run the real path once before trusting the stub's tests.
A later version inherits every earlier exclusion: leakage decisions only grow.
risks: The held-back period is version 1's: a new outcome read on it once is honest, but a third outcome on the same rows reads them again for another question.
